page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 virtual server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, which operates at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data positions this server in the middle performance tier. It achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35. Memory performance tests show a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside an uncached write bandwidth of 48.22 GB/sec. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1287.0 and a multi-core score of 11107.0, with software compilation tasks scoring 23704.0.

This server is configured for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources without local storage requirements. It demonstrates strong capability in database operations, scoring 11442.59 in Passmark database tests and executing 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second. Static web serving throughput reaches 21.45 GB/sec. For machine learning, it handles small-scale LLM inference, processing 45.98 prompt tokens per second and 12.4 text generation tokens per second on a 7B model.

Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, it provides 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB per core ratio. The instance includes a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Benchmark results indicate steady mid-range performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 11107.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 29517.51. It delivers 28.91 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. This configuration is well-suited for database operations, software compilation, web serving, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks.
